Inherited gap stays visible: delegation excludes Markdown (.md) as unsupported_ext, so planning/docs-only diffs have no OCR rule coverage; reviewers inspect those files directly and record OCR_COVERAGE_GAP unsupported_ext, never PASS.

evidence_and_pass_fail.evidence: Every result binds exact candidate revision, method, VCASE/local row, fixture/input hashes, artifact digest, named environment, command/procedure, actual observation and exit/signal; no invented hook/receipt schema.
evidence_and_pass_fail.passing: All method-specific expected observations with both criteria in allocated environment. Expected negative must be observed as rejection/containment, not treated as test-suite failure. File existence or tool exit alone is insufficient where inspection is required.
evidence_and_pass_fail.failure: Observable deviation from stated criterion on prepared article. Preserve phase and safe child error. Reproduce/classify before product-bug attribution.
evidence_and_pass_fail.gap_policy: A gap stays a gap even when owner accepts it as a residual risk; no passing binary/coverage/mutation substitute. No requirement silently removed because fallback works.
evidence_and_pass_fail.red_green: Bind baseline failing assertions and candidate passes over same named test IDs and unchanged test hashes; changes return to the red boundary.
evidence_and_pass_fail.reuse: Exact candidate and relevant input digests must match; changed contract/source/APK/fixture/tool invalidates qualification. Late docs-only merges require both product trees equal and updated docs check.
evidence_and_pass_fail.final_identity: candidate.final = P2-R5 merge on main; APK final sha256/cert, deployed backend tree, registry/fixture/contracts identities and complete step receipts. Public tag v1.0.0 absent before OA-8 is pending publication, not tagged PASS.
evidence_and_pass_fail.limits: No hardware benchmark or measured latency/RAM claim. Functional timing boundaries from register are retained. Live schedule is execution input rechecked at capture, not independently researched here.
evidence_and_pass_fail.execution_authority: Planning/tracking approval may authorize P2-L01 only after explicit approval and planning PR landing. Product/backend/spike/deployment and submission execution remain held until a subsequent owner execution instruction. Publication/public export requires separate exact-surface/history authority.

anomaly_corrective_closure.classify: Expected negative; preparation/harness/configuration/environment error; reproduced product defect; missing integration route; owner/protected boundary. Never report raw failure as product defect.
anomaly_corrective_closure.correction_bound: At most three evidence-driven planning correction rounds, each with new hypothesis and result. No independent review/assurance budget spent here.
anomaly_corrective_closure.closure: Parent reconciles final mechanical PI instructions, refreshes candidate/render and then starts the one independent planning review. This author finalization consumes no review/assurance round. Runtime work is held; Planning/tracking approval may authorize P2-L01 only after explicit approval and planning PR landing. Product/backend/spike/deployment and submission execution remain held until a subsequent owner execution instruction. Publication/public export requires separate exact-surface/history authority.
anomaly_corrective_closure.spikes: FAILS/PARTIAL/TIMEBOX is admissible truthful verdict, not a product requirement pass; C1/C5/C6/C8 control dependencies and owner stops.
anomaly_corrective_closure.rollbacks: Use IE step rollback under exact resource lease; do not execute data-clearing uninstall without applicable authorization/OA-10 relink. Preserve original failure and recovery outcomes separately.
anomaly_corrective_closure.owner_decision_rule: Existing OD/OA items remain for integrated review. Stop planning only if proof itself needs new material owner intent that source plan cannot answer; no such additional intent question introduced.
